claims.headline: the lifetime law reads the record's own liouvillian mode
claims.prose: ProjectModel.lifetime builds the two-state open system (H, {L_k}) from a surface's constants in SI and returns the reciprocal of the decay rate of the record observable itself, rate = |<R, L†R>| on the normalised record. On the CoCrPt grain (K_u = 2.0e5 J/m^3, V = 1.26e-24 m^3, T = 300 K, f0 = 1e9 Hz, dE = 3 kT, E_b/kT = 60.8410) it returns tau = 2.5223e+17 s = 7.99e9 yr, agreeing with the closed form tau = 1/(g_up + g_dn) = exp(E_b/kT)/(f0 (1 + e^(-dE/kT))) to 1.3e-16 relative. The Arrhenius rates ARE the inserted jump strengths, so that agreement is an identity of the construction; the independent content is that the instrument reads the record's own mode. Asking instead for the slowest non-zero Liouvillian mode returns the coherence at (g_up + g_dn)/2 and gives exactly twice the record's lifetime — the error the T-29 lane logged, and the reason lifetime() requires the record by name.
claims.grounding: LANE_T29_HDD/t29_grain.txt (constants, jump rates, the DEF-A control); PROVENANCE "CoCrPt grain" — Weller & Moser, IEEE Trans. Magn. 35, 4423 (1999); the C-69 demotion note in ledger/status_ledger.tsv (what fell, and the 8.4e-15 direct-time-evolution confirmation of what survived)
claims.scope: SINGLE-CARRIER — the only substantive carrier build behind this law is the macrospin CoCrPt grain (LANE_T9_AUDIT/T9_carrier_audit.tsv). The gate is an internal consistency check against the closed form of the same construction, so it is not an independent test of anything in the world, and no measured retention datum enters at any point. C-69 was DEMOTED FROM PROVED by the solidity review on 2026-08-20 and now stands at FORMAL, the grade its rows cell prints: what fell was the grounding — the stated law tau = exp(E_b/kT)/f0 contradicted its own number, and the "not by inserting the Arrhenius rate" clause was false — while the machinery survived, the record-mode extraction confirmed in the row's own note by direct time evolution at four epochs to 8.4e-15. The sealed T-29 headline 5.6279e16 s was computed under the superseded midpoint-barrier convention and does not reproduce today; the gate named above prints 2.5223e+17 s.

claims.headline: the steady value is tanh(dE/2kT), an identity of the detailed-balance construction
claims.prose: ProjectModel.steady_value takes the Liouvillian's stationary state — the eigenvector at the eigenvalue of smallest modulus, trace-normalised — and returns Tr(rho_ss R). Across the six declared surfaces it matches tanh(dE/2 k_B T) with worst absolute error 1.98e-15, live from model/validate_project.py. Detailed balance between the two Arrhenius rates forces that value exactly before any physics is consulted: the rates are BUILT as g_up/g_dn = exp(dE/kT), so <R>_ss = (g_up - g_dn)/(g_up + g_dn) = tanh(dE/2kT) algebraically. The check is therefore an identity of the construction and the closed form serves only as a check. The method carries a second guard behind that one — with an empty dissipator a stationary state is not defined, and it returns None instead of selecting a vector — but no RecordSurface can reach it, since open_system either returns None or returns two jump operators; that branch (model/project_model.py:95-96) is untriggered and untested. This block is where that guard is stated for the layer; P-LAW-5 defers to it rather than restating it.
claims.grounding: LANE_T33_ANYSURFACE/t33_anysurface.txt (LAW 1 table, six surfaces); LANE_T33_ANYSURFACE/VERIFY/verify_attack.py section C (the identity re-derived symbolically); model/project_model.py:89-101 (steady_value, including the untriggered empty-dissipator guard at :95-96); the C-70 demotion note in ledger/status_ledger.tsv; PROVENANCE entries "CoCrPt grain", "NAND floating gate", "DNA base tautomer", "Fe(II) spin crossover", "Azobenzene", "Alanine enantiomer"
claims.scope: SINGLE-CARRIER — an identity of the detailed-balance construction, checked at parameter sets; it is not a measurement. C-70 was DEMOTED FROM PROVED by the solidity review on 2026-08-20 and now stands at FORMAL: <R>_ss = tanh(dE/2kT) IS what was computed and T-30's table is genuine, but the verification is an algebraic identity of the construction, and two of the six parameter rows fell with the grounding. The T-9 audit records the six surfaces as six scalar parameter sets in one identical 2x2 GKSL model, and C-70 records those two rows (azobenzene, alanine) as WITHDRAWN literature anchors. No measured value is compared against on this face — the (dE, E_b, T, f0) fed in are literature parameter values, and zero measured data enters the tanh check itself. D-15 DEBT, NAMED AND UNPAID: the 1.98e-15 is a reported zero with no control beside it. Nothing in this layer or in its lanes builds a construction that VIOLATES detailed balance and must therefore miss tanh, so the reader cannot separate this check from the tautology the block itself says it is; a D-15 control would have to be a different configuration — rates not built to satisfy g_up/g_dn = exp(dE/kT) — and none is run.

claims.headline: both laws run unchanged on six parameter sets, to absolute machine precision
claims.prose: The same two methods run unchanged on six declared surfaces — magnetic anisotropy, trapped charge, chemical bond, spin-state transition, photoisomerisation, parity violation. Worst absolute error on the steady-state law is 1.98e-15 and worst relative error on the lifetime law is 3.97e-16, both from the live validator. The declared dE/k_B T range runs 3.87e-12 to 23.21, but its lower endpoint is the alanine parameter row that C-70 records as WITHDRAWN (dE = 1e-13 eV, "~5 orders above the literature PVED, a probable J/mol-for-eV misread"), and on that same row the sealed T-33 table's RELATIVE error is 7.00e-04; at the corrected alanine input P-LAW-7 supplies, the predicted excess 1.9e-18 to 1.9e-16 sits entirely below the 1e-15 instrument floor, so the small-dE end of the advertised span is unverifiable. On the four rows C-70 leaves standing the checked span is dE/k_B T = 2.10 to 13.10, a factor 6.2. What is not established at all is mechanism-independence: the T-9 carrier audit found the six to be six scalar parameter sets in one identical 2x2 GKSL model, and on that ground C-69 and C-70 are both marked SINGLE-CARRIER.

claims.headline: the model declines on zircon, and the decline is arithmetic
claims.prose: RecordSurface.open_system returns None where the Arrhenius rates are unrepresentable, and every law method above it returns None in turn. Zircon U-Pb is the first control, and the decline is arithmetic: model/validate_project.py:53 constructs the surface with 4.27 MeV — the census's alpha-decay WRITE energy (CENSUS_V001.md row 3, clause iv, "4–5 MeV each") — entered as BOTH the barrier and the splitting at T = 300 K with f0 = 1e21 /s, so E_b/k_B T = 1.652e8, both rates underflow, and the model names no lifetime and no steady value. This is not a finding about alpha decay. Handed the census's own zircon barrier in the barrier slot AND a 3 kT splitting in the splitting slot (Pb-diffusion Ea = 550 kJ/mol = 5.70 eV, Ea/kT = 220 at 300 K, f0 = 1e21 /s as constructed; LANE_GR1_CENSUS/numbers.txt line 12) the same instrument returns a FINITE lifetime of 5.4286e+74 s and a steady value of 0.9051 — and BOTH substitutions are needed for that pair, since with the barrier alone replaced and 4.27 MeV left in the splitting slot the instrument returns 5.6989e+74 s and a steady value of 1.0000. Either way the finiteness is the barrier slot's doing, and the underflow was the 4.27 MeV barrier's. The step from "the arithmetic underflows" to "the physics is temperature-independent" is one the model does not represent. The reported None does have its positive control beside it (D-15): in the same validator run the same instrument returns 2.5223e+17 s on the CoCrPt grain and finite values on all six declared surfaces.

claims.headline: e_b is the activation energy from the metastable well, and azobenzene decided it
claims.prose: E_b in this layer is the Arrhenius activation energy measured from the metastable (upper) well: escape from the upper well is f0 exp(-E_b/kT), from the lower well f0 exp(-(E_b + dE)/kT), and detailed balance then holds automatically. The earlier convention referred the barrier to the well midpoint, which silently reduced the escape barrier by dE/2 and shortened every lifetime by a factor exp(dE/2kT) — 4.4817 on the CoCrPt grain, exactly the gap between the sealed 5.6279e16 s and today's 2.5223e17 s. (The 2 cosh(dE/2kT) = 4.7048 that C-69's demotion note carries is a DIFFERENT ratio: the naive Neel form exp(E_b/kT)/f0 against the midpoint-convention 1/(g_up + g_dn).) Azobenzene decided the convention: at dE = 0.60 eV the midpoint reading returned tau = 0.398 s against a measured thermal cis lifetime of ~1e4-1e6 s, a 5-6 order contradiction, and the corrected convention returns 4.36e+04 s. The two closed forms are one object under a shift of reference — exp(B/kT)/(2 f0 cosh(dE/2kT)) with B = E_b + dE/2 — so the entire correction is in what E_b names.

claims.headline: the surviving-record count k(t_m), with a derived width and dated drop times
claims.prose: One criterion — clause (ii'), |lambda_record| <= 1/t_m on the record's own Liouvillian mode — dates every record's death: a record survives to t_m exactly when g_up + g_dn <= 1/t_m, equivalently when dE <= delta_pop(t_m) = kT ln(expm1(B/kT - ln f0 t_m)), and the family census is the decreasing staircase k(t_m) = #{i : dE_i <= delta_pop,i(t_m)} with drop times t*_i = f0^-1 exp((B_i - dE_i)/kT)/(1 + exp(-dE_i/kT)), each record dying at its shallower value's escape. There is no fitted width anywhere in it; the one assumption it does carry is a SHARED Kramers prefactor f0 for both wells, declared as an assumption in T-47 A's own D-24 audit and not derived. Two independent routes — a per-record eigenvalue instrument that uses no formula, and the derived staircase — give count discrepancy 0 at all 1201 t_m points on both declared multi-record surfaces, with step locations landing on t*_i to max |d ln tau| = 3.55e-15; the positive control beside that zero is the asymptotic candidate width B - kT ln(f0 t_m), a different configuration, which misses by 1 at 82 of the same points. C-76 killed the earlier reconciliation because its clustering width was chosen — an ad-hoc 1e-2 in the carrier's own units (t31_asymmetry.py:66) set against splittings of 1e-6 to 1e-1 in those same units, which is what the script's 3e36-3e41 column expresses as RATIOS against that carrier's own durability width, hbar/t_m = 3.341e-43 J at the T-31 carrier's declared t_m = 10 yr — and C-86 restores it by deriving the width from the record definition; the same clause on the off-diagonal face gives delta_coh = hbar/t_m, and on lane B's own surface (B = 1.4 eV, T = 350 K, t_m = 1 yr) that is 3.341e-42 J against a population width of 4.072e-20 J on that same surface at that same t_m, a ratio of 1.22e22, which is C-76's error quantified. The two hbar/t_m figures here are one formula at two declared t_m on two carriers, not one quantity printed at two values. The corner is recovered and corrected: at dE = 0 the staircase is flat at N with a single step at exp(B/kT)/(2 f0), measured 1.254112e+05 s on the eight-record symmetric control — a derived factor-2 correction to the commissioning text — while as t_m -> infinity the POPULATION width goes to -infinity and no thermally activated two-valued record survives at T > 0, which is DEF-A's E_b -> infinity demand recovered. It is the COHERENCE face whose width goes to zero and returns DEF-A's exact commutant count (C-75).

notes:
HOW I WORKED. Every demonstration was executed here before I accepted it; nothing was taken on a lens's word. I ran `python3 replicate/check_proof.py` (it EXISTS, is executable, and PASSES: 69 blocks, R1-R10 ok, R11 summary 69 blocks / 87 distinct rows / 39 resting on no TWO-CARRIER row / 9 carrying a PROVED row) and `cd model && python3 validate_project.py` (14 PASS, 0 FAIL, exit 0). I made direct calls into model/project_model.py and model/grounded.py, read the T-9 audit TSV, the ledger rows for C-69/C-70/C-76/C-86/C-14/C-46/C-75/G-7, and the T-29/T-31/T-33/T-41/T-47-A/B/C/D and GR1 lane files. I edited nothing in the repository.

FINDINGS I CONFIRMED AND LANDED
- SERIOUS, layer headers outside the gate (worst instance is line 347, not mine; the finding names my §2 header at line 219 for "the barrier constants"). CONFIRMED at the source: `grep -n "BLOCK_HEAD" replicate/check_proof.py` gives line 258, `BLOCK_HEAD = re.compile(r'^###\s+(P-\S+)')`, and every rule iterates parse_blocks() only — headers are outside the parse. I then audited my own header claim by claim. The break is `1.05 eV`: it appears ONCE in the whole document, in my header, and in NO block. It is azobenzene's E_b at model/validate_project.py:40. `K_u = 2.0e5 J/m^3` is fine (blocks at lines 96 and 224) and `1.60 eV` is fine (P-LAW-7, line 296). I dropped the numeric parenthetical rather than manufacture a block for it, and rewrote the header so it asserts nothing a block does not: every row grade it names is printed in a rows cell the gate checks against the ledger and the T-9 audit, and every substantive statement now carries the block that owns it. The header also now states its own status — that check_proof.py passes but parses `### P-` blocks only — so a reader knows what a header is worth.
- SERIOUS, delta_coh at two values (P-LAW-8:308 vs P-LAW-10:340). CONFIRMED and the lens's diagnosis is exactly right. `sed -n '20,29p' LANE_T47_B_STAIRCASE/t47b_staircase.txt`: surface B = 1.4 eV, T = 350 K, f0 = 1e9, t_m = 1 yr; population width 0.2542 eV = 4.072e-20 J; coherence width 3.341e-42 J; ratio 1.22e+22. `sed -n '5p' LANE_T31_ASYMMETRY/t31_asymmetry.txt`: carrier [[4,2,2]], t_m = 10 years, delta = hbar/t_m = 3.341e-43 J. Two carriers, two declared t_m, one formula — so "on the same surface" was false. P-LAW-8 now prints lane B's own pair with the surface and t_m named, keeps the T-31 figure labelled as that carrier's own width at its own t_m, and adds one sentence saying the two are one formula at two t_m so the conflation cannot reform. P-LAW-10 is left alone; it was right about the number.
- MINOR, the zircon counterfactual under-described (P-LAW-4:260). CONFIRMED through the instrument itself, not the closed form. RecordSurface(dE=3kT, E_b=5.70 eV, T=300, f0=1e21) -> lifetime 5.428555755072771e+74 s, steady value 0.9051482536448638. With the barrier alone replaced and 4.27 MeV left in the splitting slot -> 5.698827631589348e+74 s, steady value 1.0. The block's quoted pair needed BOTH substitutions and did not say so. Landed, with the second number printed beside it so the reader can see which slot does what. section_intro: The LAWS layer is what a record does in time: how long its value survives, and what value it settles to. Both laws are read from the record's own Liouvillian mode through `ProjectModel.lifetime` and `ProjectModel.steady_value`, with the closed forms used as checks and never as sources; a third law, the surviving-record count `k(t_m)`, is the same clause (ii') criterion applied to a family member by member. THIS HEADER ASSERTS NOTHING THE BLOCKS BELOW DO NOT ASSERT, and it is written that way deliberately: `replicate/check_proof.py` exists, is executable, and passes on this document, but it parses `### P-` blocks only (`replicate/check_proof.py:258`), so any number or row grade stated in a section header would sit outside the five-cell contract and outside the gate. Six ledger rows carry this layer, and each block prints its rows' status and carrier mark in the cell the gate checks against the ledger and the T-9 audit: C-69, C-70, C-76 and C-86 at FORMAL, C-14 at PARTIAL, C-46 at DEFINED. A FORMAL result is real mathematics about the model's own stipulated construction and says nothing about the world (H-3), and nothing in this layer meets the program's PROVED bar (P-LAW-7). C-14's live restriction — that its count law rests on ENGINEERED degeneracy — is exactly the corner P-LAW-8 leans on, and P-LAW-8's scope carries it rather than leaving it here. On measured data the true statement is narrower than "none enters": no measured lifetime or retention datum is a numerical INPUT to any computation in this layer, and measured values enter only as comparands — one of them, the azobenzene cis lifetime, exposed the contradiction that forced the convention correction P-LAW-6 records — while the (dE, E_b, T, f0) fed to the model are published literature parameter values and the T-41 envelopes are swept over literature (E_a, f0) ranges (P-LAW-2, P-LAW-3, P-LAW-6, P-LAW-7). Two external measured anchors sit inside computed model envelopes and a third pinned number has no envelope computed anywhere in the lane (P-LAW-7). The layer's two demoted rows, C-69 and C-70, carry that history in P-LAW-1's and P-LAW-2's scope cells: what fell was the grounding, and the machinery beneath it survived.
